{"_meta":{"io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo":{"description":"Context7 provides up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.","icons":[{"mimeType":"image/svg+xml","sizes":["any"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.svg"},{"mimeType":"image/png","sizes":["512x512"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.png"}],"name":"Context7","title":"Context7","version":"4.4.2","websiteUrl":"https://context7.com"}},"content":[{"text":"### Deferring a module with an asynchronous dependency\n\nSource: https://github.com/mdn/content/blob/main/files/en-us/web/javascript/reference/statements/import/defer/index.md\n\nEvaluates a top-level `await` module eagerly while deferring synchronous dependencies until accessed via the deferred import. The output sequence demonstrates the order of module evaluation.\n\n```javascript\n// -- config.js --\nexport const locale = await Promise.resolve(\"en-US\");\nconsole.log(\"Configuration ready\");\n```\n\n```javascript\n// -- format.js --\nconsole.log(\"Formatting module evaluated\");\n\nexport function format(value, locale) {\n  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(value);\n}\n```\n\n```javascript\n// -- report.js --\nimport { locale } from \"./config.js\";\nimport { format } from \"./format.js\";\n\nconsole.log(\"Report module evaluated\");\n\nexport function createReport(value) {\n  return format(value, locale);\n}\n```\n\n```javascript\n// -- main.js --\nimport defer * as report from \"./report.js\";\n\nconsole.log(\"Main module evaluated\");\nconsole.log(report.createReport(1000));\n```\n\n```plain\nConfiguration ready\nMain module evaluated\nFormatting module evaluated\nReport module evaluated\n1,000\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Fetch and export data using top-level await across modules\n\nSource: https://github.com/mdn/content/blob/main/files/en-us/web/javascript/guide/modules/index.md\n\nDefines a JSON palette, fetches it via top-level await in getColors.js, and imports the resolved object in main.js. The importing module waits for colors.json to resolve before executing, while sibling modules like canvas.js load concurrently.\n\n```json\n{\n  \"yellow\": \"#F4D03F\",\n  \"green\": \"#52BE80\",\n  \"blue\": \"#5499C7\",\n  \"red\": \"#CD6155\",\n  \"orange\": \"#F39C12\"\n}\n```\n\n```javascript\n// fetch request\nconst colors = fetch(\"../data/colors.json\").then((response) => response.json());\n\nexport default await colors;\n```\n\n```javascript\nimport colors from \"./modules/getColors.js\";\nimport { Canvas } from \"./modules/canvas.js\";\n\nconst circleBtn = document.querySelector(\".circle\");\n\n// …\n```\n\n```javascript\nconst square = new Module.Square(\n  myCanvas.ctx,\n  myCanvas.listId,\n  50,\n  50,\n  100,\n  colors.blue,\n);\n\nconst circle = new Module.Circle(\n  myCanvas.ctx,\n  myCanvas.listId,\n  75,\n  200,\n  100,\n  colors.green,\n);\n\nconst triangle = new Module.Triangle(\n  myCanvas.ctx,\n  myCanvas.listId,\n  100,\n  75,\n  190,\n  colors.yellow,\n);\n```\n\n### Top-level await\n\nSource: https://github.com/mdn/content/blob/main/files/en-us/web/javascript/reference/statements/import/defer/index.md\n\nReading a namespace property is synchronous, so it cannot wait for asynchronous module evaluation. Modules that contain [top-level `await`](/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Modules#top_level_await) are evaluated eagerly, along with the dependencies required to evaluate them. This includes modules reached through further deferred imports. The importing module waits for this asynchronous evaluation before running its own body.\n\nIf the directly imported module contains top-level `await`, its evaluation is not deferred. If only some of its dependencies contain top-level `await`, those dependencies are evaluated eagerly, but the synchronous parts of the graph that are not required for their evaluation can remain deferred. See [Deferring a module with an asynchronous dependency](#deferring_a_module_with_an_asynchronous_dependency).\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Top level await\n\nSource: https://github.com/mdn/content/blob/main/files/en-us/web/javascript/guide/modules/index.md\n\nTop level await is a feature available within modules. This means the `await` keyword can be used. It allows modules to act as big [asynchronous functions](/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Async_JS/Introducing) meaning code can be evaluated before use in parent modules, but without blocking sibling modules from loading.\n\nLet's take a look at an example. You can find all the files and code described in this section within the [`top-level-await`](https://github.com/mdn/js-examples/tree/main/module-examples/top-level-await) directory, which extends from the previous examples.\n\nFirstly we'll declare our color palette in a separate [`colors.json`](https://github.com/mdn/js-examples/blob/main/module-examples/top-level-await/data/colors.json) file:\n\nThen we'll create a module called [`getColors.js`](https://github.com/mdn/js-examples/blob/main/module-examples/top-level-await/modules/getColors.js) which us
